fullDescription: Record command inverses/history across GUI and CLI session edits, expose dirty/save state, and recover autosaves after crashes. Acceptance: undo ordering is defined for external edits and recovery never replaces original silently.

title: Add undo, redo, dirty state, and autosave recovery
